description: This file contains the implementation of a find and replace dialog plugin for CKEditor, including functions for text search, highlighting, and replace operations within the editor.

classes.name: characterWalker
classes.description: Iterator class for walking through characters in a range, supporting forward and backward movement, highlighting, and range updates.

classes.name: characterRange
classes.description: Represents a range of characters for find/replace operations, supporting highlighting, matching, and cursor management.

classes.name: kmpMatcher
classes.description: Implements the Knuth-Morris-Pratt algorithm for pattern matching within the text.

methods.name: syncFieldsBetweenTabs
methods.description: Synchronizes input fields between 'find' and 'replace' tabs in the dialog.

methods.name: findDialog
methods.description: Creates and returns the configuration object for the find/replace dialog, including event handlers and UI elements.

methods.name: getSearchRange
methods.description: Determines the initial search range based on user selection or full document.
